// NEGATIVE counterpart to the desync fixture: the same regex-after-keyword shapes, but every
// construct is Node 13.2-legal, so the gate must report nothing. Read as division instead of a
// regex, the bodies below would land in the scanned code and manufacture violations that are not
// in this file.
export function isContraction(word) {
  return /don't/.test(word);
}

export function hasLogicalAssign(source) {
  return /\|\|=|&&=/.test(source);
}

export function kindOf(value) {
  return typeof /it's a regex/.exec(String(value));
}

export function ratio(a, b) {
  // Division after an identifier, after `)` and after `]` must stay division.
  return a / b;
}

export function rates(list, seconds) {
  return (list[0] + list[1]) / seconds;
}

export function withDefault(value, fallback) {
  return value === null || value === undefined ? fallback : value;
}
